wanted.title: Boy Who Wouldn't Hoe Corn, The

candidate.song_name: The Boy Who Wouldnt Hoe Corn

content:
[Verse 1]

[tab][ch]Dm[/ch]                                        [ch]Bb[/ch]
Tell you a little story and it won't take long[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                                        [ch]Dm[/ch]
'Bout a lazy farmer who wouldn't hoe his corn[/tab]
[tab][ch]Dm[/ch]                           [ch]Bb[/ch]
The reason why I never could tell[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                         [ch]Dm[/ch]
That young man was always well[/tab]


[Verse 2]
[tab][ch]Dm[/ch]                                  [ch]Bb[/ch]
He planted his corn in the month of June[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                                        [ch]Dm[/ch]
By July it was up to his eyes[/tab]
[tab][ch]Dm[/ch]                              [ch]Bb[/ch]
Come September there came a big frost[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                                [ch]Dm[/ch]
And all the young man's corn was lost[/tab]


[Verse 3]
[tab][ch]Dm[/ch]                       [ch]Bb[/ch]
His courtship had just begun[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                                        [ch]Dm[/ch]
Said young man, "Have you hauled some corn?"[/tab]
[tab][ch]Dm[/ch]                                       [ch]Bb[/ch]
"Well I tried and I tried and I tried in vain,[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                                 [ch]Dm[/ch]
But I don't believe I raised one grain."[/tab]


[Verse 4]
[tab][ch]Dm[/ch]                                       [ch]Bb[/ch] 
Well he went down town to his neighbor's door[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                        [ch]Dm[/ch]
Where he had often been before[/tab]
[tab][ch]Dm[/ch]                                       [ch]Bb[/ch]
Sayin "Pretty little miss will you marry me,[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                        [ch]Dm[/ch]
Little miss what do you say?"[/tab]


[Verse 5]
[tab][ch]Dm[/ch]                          [ch]Bb[/ch]
"Why do you come for me to wed?[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                                [ch]Dm[/ch]
You can't even make your own cornbread[/tab]
[tab][ch]Dm[/ch]                     [ch]Bb[/ch]
Single I am and will remain.[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                         [ch]Dm[/ch]
A lazy man I won't maintain."[/tab]


[Verse 6]
[tab][ch]Dm[/ch]                            [ch]Bb[/ch]
He turned his back and walked away[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                                [ch]Dm[/ch]
Sayin "Little miss you'll rue the day.[/tab]
[tab][ch]Dm[/ch]                                [ch]Bb[/ch]
You'll rue the day that you were born[/tab]
[tab] [ch]C[/ch]                                      [ch]Dm[/ch]
Givin me the devil cause I wouldn't hoe corn."[/tab]
